card.name: The word term after long
card.fires_on: The word "term" (or "-term") right after "long", as in "long-term" or "Long Term". It appears in warnings and safety text, and also in names and general web text.

modes.label: long-term in label text
modes.description: "term" completes "long-term" in safety statements about use, safety or effects.
modes.example: WARNING: POTENTIAL RISK OF MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION WITH LONG-<<TERM>> USE: FOR SHORT-TERM HOSP

modes.label: Long Term in names
modes.description: "Term" follows "Long" in a capitalized name or title.

card.plain: It fires on the word "term" when it finishes "long-term".
